items.question: What is EventTick?
items.answer: EventTick is a Lifestyle countdown app for iOS. Name a date, pick a style, and keep it on your iPhone Home Screen. Free on the App Store (id6813929052). Google Play coming soon. Package: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.

items.question: Do I need an account?
items.answer: No. Events stay on your device. Crash and usage diagnostics go to Firebase.

items.question: What is included for free?
items.answer: Three events, three countdown styles, four accents, Minimal and Compact widgets, and optional ads (banner plus occasional interstitial).

items.question: What does Premium add?
items.answer: Unlimited events, all eight countdown styles and eight accents, every widget look, and no ads. Product ID: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.premium. Recommended price USD $3.99, one-time, not a subscription.

items.question: Which countdown styles are available?
items.answer: Breaking Down, Total Days, Weeks & Days, Months & Days, The Big Number, Orbit, Momentum, and Immersive. Free unlocks the first three; Premium unlocks all eight.

items.question: Does EventTick have Home Screen widgets?
items.answer: Yes on iPhone. Pin a countdown on the Home Screen. Free includes Minimal and Compact looks; Premium unlocks the rest. Google Play (and Android widgets) coming soon.

items.question: Does EventTick show ads?
items.answer: Yes on the free plan: a banner and an occasional interstitial via Google AdMob. Premium removes ads.

items.question: Where are my events stored?
items.answer: On your device. Uninstalling EventTick deletes local events.

items.question: How do I restore Premium?
items.answer: Open Settings and tap Restore purchases with the same Apple ID. Product ID: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.premium. Google Play coming soon.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy Policy for EventTick — Event Countdown.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Zuki Apps handles information when you use EventTick and related pages at zukiapps.com/eventtick.

section1.title: 1. Who we are
section1.content: The data controller is Zuki Apps. Contact details are at the end of this Policy.
section1.content2: This Policy applies to the EventTick app and the legal pages we publish for the product.

section2.title: 2. Information we collect
section2.content: EventTick is designed to work on-device. We collect limited data to run the app and optional purchases.
items: Event names, dates, styles, accents, and Premium status stored on device
Crash and usage diagnostics sent to Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics
Advertising identifiers if you allow tracking (iOS App Tracking Transparency)
Feedback and support messages you send
Purchase records handled by Apple or Google — tokens only, not full card data

section3.title: 3. How we use information
items: Operate and improve EventTick
Show ads to free players (Google AdMob)
Respond to support requests
Validate in-app purchases
section3.content2: We do not sell your personal information.

section4.title: 4. Advertising and tracking
section4.content: Free players may see Google AdMob banners and interstitials. On iOS we request tracking permission before personalized ads.
section4.content2: You can limit ad tracking in system settings. Premium removes ads.

section5.title: 5. Storage and retention
section5.content: Event data remains on device until you uninstall.
section5.content2: Ad and purchase partners retain data under their own policies.

section6.title: 6. Third-party services
section6.content: Google AdMob (ads), Firebase (Crashlytics and Analytics), Apple App Store, and Google Play Billing may process data under their policies.
section6.content2: Crash reports are sent with Firebase Crashlytics in release builds. We do not sell your personal information.

section7.title: 7. Your rights and children
section7.content: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or object to certain processing. Contact us to exercise rights.
section7.content2: EventTick is a general-audience utility. It is not directed to children under 13.

section8.title: 8. Changes
section8.content: We may update this Policy from time to time. We will post the revised version with a new Last updated date.

q1.question: How many events can I add?
q1.answer: Free includes 3 events. Premium unlocks unlimited events.

q2.question: Do widgets need an internet connection?
q2.answer: No. Countdowns run on your device.

q3.question: How do I restore Premium?
q3.answer: Use Restore purchases in Settings after reinstall. Payments are processed by Apple or Google. Product ID: com.zuki.apps.eventtick.premium.

q4.question: Where are my events stored?
q4.answer: On your device. Uninstalling the app deletes local events.

q5.question: Does EventTick show ads?
q5.answer: Yes on the free plan via Google AdMob (banner and occasional interstitial). Premium removes ads.

q6.question: Which styles are free?
q6.answer: Free includes Breaking Down, Total Days, and Weeks & Days. Premium unlocks Months & Days, The Big Number, Orbit, Momentum, and Immersive.

q7.question: Is Premium a subscription?
q7.answer: No. EventTick Premium is a one-time purchase. Recommended price USD $3.99.

q8.question: How do I contact support?
q8.answer: Email zuki.apps.dev@gmail.com. We typically respond within 24–48 hours.
